m: Pork: mix the mince with lemongrass paste, half the garlic, half the fish sauce, half the sugar and pepper. Roll into small flat patties.
Nuoc cham: the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with lime juice, the rest of the garlic, sliced chilli and 2 tbsp water per serve. Taste: it should be salty, sweet and sour.
Cook the vermicelli per the packet (usually 3 to 4 minutes), rinse under cold water and drain well.
Pan-fry the patties in a hot pan 3 minutes a side until caramelised.
Prep the salad: shredded lettuce, cucumber and carrot matchsticks, a pile of mint and coriander, crushed peanuts.
Bowls: noodles, salad, pork, herbs and peanuts. Pour the nuoc cham over at the table.
l: A great cold lunch. Pack the dressing separately and pour it on just before eating.
g: Naturally gluten free with rice noodles. Check the fish sauce label.
